title: Mortgages are the concentration risk
finding: Mortgages are 9.8% of accounts but 52.3% of originated exposure and 65.0% of defaulted dollars. Their 24.7% default rate is the highest of any product (others: 13.9% to 16.2%) even though they are secured, and 240-month mortgages reach 29.2%.
so_what: Review mortgages first and tighten long-term underwriting. Collateral values are needed from the bank, because the actual loss cannot be sized without them.

title: Income and employment together separate risk
finding: Default falls from 32.4% under $40k to 9.5% at $100k+. Unemployed borrowers are 4.9% of accounts but 10.6% of defaults. Unemployed mortgages default at 54.3% (70 accounts, $15.6M). Contract borrowers run 35.1% under $40k but 12.8% at $60-80k.
so_what: Apply a hard policy rule to mortgages for unemployed applicants, and assess contract workers by income rather than treating them as one group.

title: Pricing does not reflect income risk
finding: The average interest rate is 11.8% to 12.0% in every income band, while default rate runs from 9.5% to 32.4%. Within personal loans, rate and income are uncorrelated (r = -0.02).
so_what: The strongest risk driver in the portfolio is not priced in, so low-income borrowers are under-charged for their risk. A risk-based pricing review is worth testing.

title: Delinquency alerts miss nearly half of defaults, and collections are not targeted
finding: 46.7% of defaulters never missed a payment in 12 months. Only 38.0% of defaulted accounts had any collections action, while 3,380 non-defaulted accounts did. Recoveries equal 0.99% of defaulted loan amounts.
so_what: Prioritise collections by model score rather than by missed payments alone, and audit the collections data first: 44.9% of events are dated before the loan began.

title: Region is not a useful lever; age is, with a caveat
finding: Regions span only 15.0% to 16.9% (channel 15.4%-16.9%, purpose 14.9%-16.9%, sector 15.0%-17.0%). Age falls from 22.2% at 21-25 to 10.6% at 56+, and the gradient holds within every product.
so_what: Drop region-based risk strategy. Age predicts default but raises fair-lending concerns, so it needs compliance review before any use in decisions.
